definitions.short: Abed-Nego , the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions
definitions.full: H5664. Abed Nego נְגוֺ עֲבֵד proper name, masculine ( servant of (God) Nebo , נְגוֺ being corrupt (intentional or unintentional) for נבוֺ (q. v.) COT Dan 1:7 Bev 1:7 ); — Babylonian name of Azariah, one of the three companions of Daniel 1:7 (see also Biblical Aramaic); ᵐ5 Theod Αβδεναγω .

occurrences.englishText: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
